answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network anchors identity verification along a cryptographically verifiable ridge where each registered agent must execute stake burning. By linking dynamic stake requirements to aggregate network saturation, costs scale superlinearly as an exponential function of active identities. Attacker expenditures grow exponentially with scale, rendering multi-identity proliferation economically ruinous.
